title: Model Order Reduction for Parametric Dissipative Quantum Systems
summary: We consider reduced basis approximations of non-equilibrium steady states of parameter-dependent Lindbladians, whose ambient matrix space grows exponentially with system size. We give a unified structural view of the problem through its characterizations as an eigenvalue problem or as a trace-constrained source problem. Building on these characterizations, we propose a residual-driven reduced basis framework for both formulations. Under the assumption of a unique steady state, we derive residual-based state-error estimates, and establish (sub-)exponential convergence of the greedy algorithms…
